title: generate_all_charts.ipynb

canonical_node.axiom: All project visualizations shall be generated from a single, reproducible notebook execution.
definitions: Master chart generator: a single notebook that imports all data and produces the complete visualization suite.
Publication-ready output: PNG files at 300 DPI, saved under /content/charts/ with subdirectories field_theory/, lagrangian/, biblical/, summary/.
derivation: The project requires consistent, publication-ready visualizations across multiple domains.
A single notebook can import all data and generate all charts, avoiding the need to run multiple notebooks.
Separating chart generation from test notebooks keeps tests clean and visualizations consistent.
Therefore, generate_all_charts.ipynb is the designated production pipeline for all visualizations.
canonical_node.action: Run generate_all_charts.ipynb to produce all charts, saving them to /content/charts/ in PNG format at 300 DPI, organized by category.
boundary: Does not perform new scientific analysis or tests; it only visualizes existing data.
Does not guarantee the correctness of the underlying data or models.
Does not define the specific chart styles or data sources; those are assumed to be provided.
test: Execute the notebook and verify that all expected chart files are created in the correct directories.
Check that each chart is in PNG format and has a resolution of 300 DPI.
Compare the summary scorecard dashboard output to the COLAB_MASTER output for consistency.

dg1_dependencies: All underlying data and model outputs from the various test notebooks.
The plotting libraries and environment available in the Colab notebook.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a single-entry-point production pipeline for generating all visualizations, ensuring consistency and saving time.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the ability to generate each individual chart as before, but centralizes the process.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this notebook, visualizations would need to be generated from multiple notebooks, risking inconsistency and inefficiency.

overstatement_risks: The document implies the notebook produces publication-ready charts, but no evidence of actual output quality is provided.
The claim that it is the 'one-stop chart generator' is an operational convenience, not a scientific result.
kill_conditions: If the notebook fails to execute or produce the expected charts.
If the charts are not reproducible in a fresh Colab session.
risk.lean_target: A reproducible script that generates all charts from the project's data.

plain_summary: This document describes a Colab notebook that generates all project visualizations in one run. It is an operational tool, not a scientific claim. The notebook is intended to produce publication-ready charts, but no verification of its output is provided.
